notes.title: Coridden is Out Now! 🎉
notes.content:
[h3][b]We are thrilled to announce that Coridden is now available! 🥳[/b][/h3] 
This colourful aRPG is a testament to the love for gaming and will be a treat to any fan of the genre.

[h3][b]See the Launch Trailer:[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=O_mnPa8t23A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Coridden[/b] is an [b]action RPG[/b] where you play as a monster-shifter, able to [b]transform into the creatures you defeat.[/b] Venture out alone or in [b]CO-OP[/b] with [b]up to 3 friends[/b] on a journey to uncover the dark secrets sealed inside the legendary city of Aasha.

🦕 [b]BECOME A SHIFTER[/b] - Switch between your human and beast form freely to utilize each form's strengths and skills when needed.

🏹 [b]ACTION FOCUSED COMBAT[/b] - Experience intense combat action where both your own skill and character gear matters.

⚡️ [b]GROW YOUR POWERS[/b] - Build up both your human and monster form with new gear, attributes, active and passive skills as you level up.

🦹‍♂️ 🦸‍♀️ [b]RIDE OUT SOLO OR IN CO-OP[/b] - Up to 4 players can play together in drop in/drop out co-op gameplay, both locally and online. 

🏇🏻 [b]HOP ON MY BACK[/b] - Ride on each other’s back to become a strong cavalry unit together!

🌺 [b]EXPLORE THE WORLD OF HEERA[/b] - Jump, swim, use fire and break walls to access and explore everything from dangerous caves to old structures, in order to solve quests and find loot.

[h3][b]🐲 Play now![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656930/Coridden/

notes.title: Telefrag VR is available now! Let's get to fraggin'!
notes.content:
Gladiators, the wait is over!

[b]Telefrag VR[/b] is now available on [i]Steam Store[/i], [i]Oculus Store[/i], and [i]PlayStation Store[/i]. Make sure you have what it takes to become a space gladiator. Prepare your VR headset and one of the supported controllers (from[i] Touch Controllers[/i] to [i]3dRudder[/i] and [i]PS Aim[/i] (coming soon)!) In case if you still wondering, here's the new Telefrag VR Launch Trailer. Check it out! :) 

[h1][b]WATCH TELEFRAG VR LAUNCH TRAILER[/b][/h1]

https://youtu.be/_oqqPjjnvCo

[b]Compete on 5 unique arenas:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3416441791721215769]The Fallen Champion[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1790650479305621608]The Mobius Villa[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3238563562763926826]The Lazarus Grotto[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1584619034834529250]The Imperial Shipyard[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1587997910857016161]The Six Leagues Under[/url]. Each of them will give you a completely different experience, but above all, many challenges. We put in your hands a full arsenal of destruction, inspired by the legendary tools of extermination from the classic 90's FPS games: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1587997910828357719]Particle Cannon[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1586870199334744792]Laser Pistol[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1716342347265826513]Plasma Rifle[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1716342347256803087]Flak Cannon[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1760253077595727194]Rocket Launcher[/url]. Pick the best loadouts, conquer the enemies, and finally make a name for yourself - [b]The Champion.
[/b]

[h1][b]TELEFRAG VR MAIN FEATURES[/b][/h1]

For those who are not following our news, here's the short brief, what are the core features of the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/7c157820a99999992c7e2e37891f38750a1d3ad2.jpg[/img]

Telefrag VR is set in an alternative universe where the Roman Empire never collapsed and instead consolidated its power on earth and continued to expand into outer space. The conquering of new systems and races, and development of new technologies ushered in a new era of gladiator battles. 

•	[b]Loadout Management[/b] – Players have a chance to utilize different loadouts, each containing two weapons. Every weapon features two firing modes and a unique teleportation attack.

•	[b]Teleport Attacks and Telefrags[/b] – Teleporting allows players’ contact weapons to inflict “Melee Damage” as they shift from one point of the arena to the next, adding an extra layer to the standard teleport mechanic used in VR.

•	[b]Guns[/b] – Projectile weapons inflict “Ranged Damage” upon the target. The game features well-known classic arena shooter weapons.

•	[b]Fast-Paced matches[/b] – You have two different locomotion types at your disposal. Get comfortable with dash movement or experience, why gladiatorial battles are reserved for the most persistent ones in the free locomotion.

•	[b]Impossible Spaces[/b] – Walkable surfaces can be placed regardless of gravity, allowing the player to travel on any designated surface regardless of its rotation and position relative to the “real” floor. This enables multiple angles of attacks and passages through play space, and as a result a fresh take on competitive level design. 

•	[b]Arena Game Mode[/b] – A 1v1 gameplay mode where the player enters an arena with 5 weapons ready to pick. Choose two of them to compose the best loadout.  We put in your hands (both hands actually) a full arsenal of destruction, inspired by the legendary tools of extermination from the classic 90's FPS games. 


[h1][b]NEED SUPPORT? WANNA PLAY? CONTACT US[/b][/h1]

[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/4o111Ym.jpg[/IMG]

In case of any problems with the game, feel free to contact us, using [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/916100/discussions/1/]Steam forum [/url][/b]or our [b][url=https://discord.gg/xT8nQJ7]Discord channel[/url][/b]. We'll try to investigate the incoming bug reports as soon as possible. Also, make sure that you're on the loop, 'cause our team is ready to rock with you on [b]Telefrag VR[/b] arenas! You will find all the details on Discord.

In behalf of the whole Telefrag VR Team, we hope that Telefrag VR succesfully inject some classic arena shooters vibe to the virtual reality. [b]Let's Get to Fraggin'! [/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z32drG7.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/

notes.title: Introducing The Six Leagues Under - Telefrag VR
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CBMgbAz.jpg[/img]

Hi there,

We're more than happy to show you 5th map from [b]Telefrag VR[/b] - Six Leagues Under. So far you had the chance to visit the monument of old times - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3416441791721215769][i]The Fallen Champion[/i][/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1790650479305621608][i]The Mobius Villa[/i][/url] - based on classic Roman architecture, swampy area - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3238563562763926826][i]The Lazarus Grotto[/i][/url] and closed, industrial map - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1584619034834529250][i]The Imperial Shipyard[/i][/url].

Today we go deep into the ground! 

[h1][b]THE SIX LEAGUES UNDER[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m292iRS.jpg[/img]

Dirty, forgotten underground corridors no longer meet their original function. Overgrown with mushrooms, moss and twisting roots, the catacombs gained disgrace in the Empire. This arena is not the most pleasant, but for the gladiators fighting for their glory, the visual layer goes to the background. All you need is a victory. Let us describe the most exciting sections of [b]The Six Leagues Under[/b].


[img]https://i.imgur.com/S7efIvb.jpg[/img]

You can map the arena on the wheel plan. The main level of the platform is a long, curved path where you will find various health pickups, along with the armor pickup belt, which is hidden behind a central platform. You can access this platform only by using the teleport gun. From the central platform, it's easy to get to the other levels, which of course, as befits futuristic arena, are turned 180 degrees apart from each other. It's easy to get confused out there.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/saPpOwz.jpg[/img]

A rock cliff (with characteristically twisted roots) deserves a lot of attention. It opens up  four different platforms that you can get to. This is a turning point on the map where you can surprise the enemy and change your attack path. Remember, however, that you can also access more places thanks to teleporting gates, so remember our words. There are no dead ends on Six Leagues Under. Always be on guard, because you can have an enemy on your back!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/fF3Ykpu.jpg[/img]

What weapons do we recommend at Six Leagues Under? Above all, Flak Cannon should be in your inventory with the Sticky Shells firing mode enabled. It can be deployed in places where the player can ultimately be spawned. Especially teleporting above, you don't know what is waiting for you. We discourage Laser Pistol because there is too much of a risk of missing shots unless you count on luck and ricocheting, after bouncing off the rocks.


How do you rate the latest map? Feel free to share your thoughts about the catacombs in the comment section!

[h1][b]ADD TELEFRAG TO YOUR WISHLIST[/b][/h1]

Set in an alternative universe where the Roman Empire never collapsed, you step into the shoes of a new breed of a gladiator on the road to becoming a champion. Use your speed, accuracy, and wits to outmaneuver and defeat your enemies, crushing them beneath your feet. Telefrag VR is coming to Oculus Rift, HTC Vive, WMR, and PlayStation VR this summer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/

notes.title: Tools of Destruction: The Particle Cannon
notes.content:
Hi!

This week we want to take a closer look at another weapon from the available arsenal that awaits you in [b]Telefrag VR[/b]. As you all know, long-distance heavy caliber isn't always the most effective choice. Especially in a place where there is little space to fight, or no chance to lead a successful attack, because you must first think about how to avoid an upcoming cannonade. [b]The Particle Cannon[/b] could be a perfect choice then. A small, malicious abcess, which you should consider if you like to derange the opponent.

[h1][b]INTRODUCING THE PARTICLE CANNON[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/581e4b01c41535f4c7fa3f2c2d970c52613622d9.png[/img]


[i]"The weapon shoots a straight, continuous lightning bolt punishing back anyone foolish enough to stand out in the open. Come in too close, and the alternative mode will snap and follow you. You can thank q3a's lightning gun for that treatment."
[/i]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/L0k7r4C1zQLXUtnoqe/giphy.gif[/img]

This is what makes [b]Particle Cannon[/b] very useful. What can irritate more than a continuous bunch of electrical bolts that unscrupulously reduce your health to none? If you find yourself in a similar situation, remember to use the Teleport Attack to change the location on the map or quickly look for a health pickup nearby.


The Particle Cannon impresses with its appearance. It may not be as tasteful as The Laser Pistol, but nothing is better than golden decor on white elements of the weapon forearm. The burnt muzzle adds the only charm and reminds you that this nonpareil can be devastating.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KEGiJxq9g6VtIPabCr/giphy.gif[/img]

Particle Cannon is a choice for anyone brave enough to get close enough to the enemy. I mean very close. Short range is undoubtedly the biggest disadvantage. Let us know what you think about the new weapon in the comments.


[h1][b]ADD TELEFRAG TO YOUR WISHLIST[/b][/h1]

Set in an alternative universe where the Roman Empire never collapsed, you step into the shoes of a new breed of a gladiator on the road to becoming a champion. Use your speed, accuracy, and wits to outmaneuver and defeat your enemies, crushing them beneath your feet. 
[b]Telefrag VR[/b] is coming to [b]Oculus Rift, HTC Vive[/b], [b]WMR[/b], and [b]PlayStation VR[/b] this summer.

notes.title: Introducing The Imperial Shipyard - Telefrag VR
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iWPtbCT.jpg[/img]

Hello, Gladiators!

It's finally time to reveal our fourth map, that will appear in [b]Telefrag VR[/b]. So far, you had the chance to visit the monument of old times - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3416441791721215769][i]The Fallen Champion[/i][/url], as well as [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1790650479305621608][i]The Mobius Villa[/i][/url] - based on classic Roman architecture. Two weeks ago, we switched the angle to another planet in the universe. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3238563562763926826][i]The Lazarus Grotto[/i][/url] doesn't look like a holiday resort. Swamps effectively deter unauthorized guests.

[h1][b]THE IMPERIAL SHIPYARD[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JPw6BtD.jpg[/img]

The shipyard is overwhelming with its industrial character. You will not find here anything but big cylinders, metal stairs and corridors winding along pipes and other raw materials. The enclosed area is isolated from the sunlight, which should alert you and make you more cautious when crossing the map. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6jBFind.jpg[/img]

[b]The most critical spots[/b] include a sloping platform in the distance, which in its position seems to be the perfect passage to the next level. However, its open nature means that you can quickly become a target. Another bottleneck is the corridor, with path crossing in different directions and orientation towards the earth.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oWIXEbd.jpg[/img]

[b]Mega health[/b] is located on the highest level of construction. You can get there thanks to the previously mentioned places, or using small gaps between the walls and ceilings. Teleport orb does not need much space, which means you can quickly disappear from the enemy's sight for a short time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pjCRPU4.jpg[/img]

Especially [b]Flak Cannon[/b] and [b]Particle Cannon[/b] could be useful in the Imperial Shipyard. You will not find many opportunities to fight for a long distance here.

How do you rate the latest map? Feel free to share your thoughts about the shipyard in the comment section!

notes.title: Puke or not to puke - Get comfortable with these settings
notes.content:
Comfort in VR is undoubtedly a thing that every developer has to take care of, so that the game can be not only exciting but also does not cause motion sickness.

Many of you can remember, what gameplay our previous VR game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/436230/Detached/][b]Detached[/b][/url], offered. Space survival allowed to move in all axes in a state of weightlessness. What could cause full freedom in 360 degrees? Just look at the gif below :)

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZYWK76iITqSjHCpLuB/giphy.gif[/img]


Of course, such sensations were only possible in the hardcore steering mode, with the assistants turned off. Despite everything, we took your feedback after the last game, pre-alpha and open beta phase of Telefrag development. What comfort setting did we prepare in Telefrag VR?

[i]First of all, creating a VR game requires a lot of restrictions. We had to keep in mind that spatial immersion has to be preserved as much as possible, without decreasing extreme sensations during the game. Telefrag VR had to be adapted to play in at least 60 frames per second, and the user interface had to be part of the virtual world. The gameplay is fast-paced, so any frame drops can cause a distraction. The player must be able to look around even in the game menu, waiting for a match to start. 
[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/krHCLug.png[/img]

Thanks to Detached, we understand the motion sickness problem very well. Based on these experiences, we decided to implement in Telefrag VR the so-called dash movement, which aims to reduce the problem, while maintaining the dynamics of the game, which is our priority. However, during the Open Beta on Steam, the player indicated that they expect us to add smooth-locomotion as an alternative. The request for smooth locomotion came from players who could be assigned to a group of hardcore players.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TiaPK74CzoLEK0QRjk/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Tools of Destruction: Laser Pistol
notes.content:
Hi!


So far, we shared more details about Telefrag VR's powerful weapons: [i]Rocket Launcher[/i],[i] Flak Cannon[/i], and [i]Plasma Rifle[/i]. Each weapon has its advantages and disadvantages, but one thing is sure. Firing a bunch of missiles or full-auto spread will not give you the satisfaction of getting a perfect headshot with [b]The Laser Pistol[/b]! Meet the tiny but powerful weapon that gladiators will master during the deadly games in the futuristic vision of the Empire.

[h1][b]INTRODUCING THE LASER PISTOL[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/80b1df756042e12e21731a095e59904740f35540.jpg[/img]


[i]The aim, pull the trigger, watch your enemy explode from across the map. Precision is the name of the game when it comes to the laser pistol. For a weapon that fires a ricocheting beam that deals enormous amounts of damage, we wanted the look to be lean, mean, and somewhat sophisticated.[/i]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Ypx8hNd2veV5IHH5Hu/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]The Laser Pistol[/b] captivates with fancy engravings both the handle and the metal parts that run from the trigger guard to the slide. Like every weapon in Telefrag, this gun also has a display, informing about the current ammo and mag and the enabled firing mode. Remember, you also have a teleport attack ready to use.

Surprise your opponent or change position on the map instantly. Like Desert Eagle in modern FPS, the Laser does not forgive mistakes, but perfect aiming rewards you with high damage points when the well-targeted bullet hits an opponent. Besides, laser beams can bounce off the walls, so you're able to hit the enemy, hiding around the corner.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YQHJ5wsCjLSElGojtm/giphy.gif[/img]

It seems to us that a weapon will find many fans, not only as a secondary weapon. Let us know what you think about the new weapon in the comments! You can read more about other weapons in the article: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1598127930597068809][i]Classic FPS DNA - Part One: Guns, Big F#cking Guns[/i][/url].

notes.title: Classic FPS DNA - Part One: Guns, Big F#cking Guns
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators!

To create the Telefrag VR, we asked ourselves: how would it be to play [b][i]Unreal Tournament[/i][/b] or [b][i]Quake III Arena[/i][/b] in Virtual Reality? We would like present to you how inspirations from these great titles are and will be visible in our game at various levels. Let's start with the weapons and their cool inspirations, which you've probably know very good.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Bep1JIh.png[/img]

Just like in Unreal Tournament in Telefrag VR, each of the weapons has two shooting modes, but unlike UT or Quake 3 Arena, you can use both weapons (one per hand) at the same time. Thanks to this, you increase the possibility of carrying out more complex attacks. Just imagine it. You shoot at the opponent, and at the same time, you launch teleport attack to change the position.


[h1][b]ROCKET LAUNCHER[/b][/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kcTyPDfJ8iwK013gHI/giphy.gif[/img]

Tools of doom are one of the pillars of a good FPS, especially if they guarantee destruction without requiring any particular precision. That's why in our game we add an absolute "must have": Rocket Launcher, which, like the one from Unreal Tournament, allows you to fire more rockets simultaneously (after having loaded them).


[h1][b]FLAK CANNON[/b][/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/SVNXkBoOWFR7oNi5iI/giphy.gif[/img]

Unreal Tournament iconic weapon, also here is a tool of pure brutality, but also... cunningness, because alternative mode allows you to create deadly mines just from the shells.


[h1][b]PLASMA RIFLE[/b][/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/S6H24eMRrcYokBc8dQ/giphy.gif[/img]

Another classic weapon inspired by Plasma Gun from Quake 3 Arena - it`s better not to overheat this gun. 


[h1][b]LASER PISTOL[/b][/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Ie9EqBX5uUTLFKRs4z/giphy.gif[/img]

Aim, pull the trigger, watch your entire map. Precision is the name of the laser pistol. Firing a ricocheting beam that deals huge amounts of damage. It is a weapon dedicated to all those who loved duels on Rail Guns.

[h1][b]PARTICLE CANNON[/b][/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Js2kU2m4X3ORWsP5q7/giphy.gif[/img]

The weapon shoots a straight, continuous lightning bolt punishing anyone foolish enough to stand out in the visible spot. Come in too close, and the alternative mode will snap and follow you. This is how a gun inspired by Lighting Gun works.


Let us know which weapons from the classic FPS you remember most. In the following weeks, we'll show you more details about the upcoming weapons, mentioned above :)

---

notes.title: Introducing The Lazarus Grotto - Telefrag VR
notes.content:
[h1][b]THE LAZARUS GROTTO[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cj7mI9L.jpg[/img]

Hi there,

So far we have shared with you two maps from Telefrag VR - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3416441791721215769][i]The Fallen Champion[/i][/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1790650479305621608][i]The Mobius Villa[/i][/url]. You had the opportunity to play on the first one during open beta back in March. It's finally time to unveil the secrets about the latest map, called [b]The Lazarus Grotto[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kZjbO5E.jpg[/img]

Do you remember Dagobah from the most popular movie saga? We could say that this comparison perfectly reflected what can be found on this swampy planet. Dirty wetlands arouse anxiety, so you better don't leave the playing field. Nobody knows what can be hidden in the nearby wetlands.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IROYizQ.jpg[/img]

The arena winds around the rock formation, which allows you to fight on several levels. What is undoubtedly the advantage of [b]The Lazarus Grotto[/b] - there are no dead ends here. It means that the fight can be carried out non-stop, and your plan of attack can be based not only on two-way teleport gateways but also on narrow spaces between rocks. Use the teleport attack to get to the other end of the arena, or change the location by 180 degrees and be upside down.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zDqLhnI.jpg[/img]

There is a lot of useful pickups, placed around the map. Make sure that you know the location of the mega-health pickup at higher levels and a pickup armor belt at level 0.


How do you rate the latest map? Feel free to share your thoughts about the map in the comment section! :) In the following weeks we will show you new weapons and the upcoming maps from Telefrag VR. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Crossplay PvP - WHY should you care and something more...
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators! 

We decided to add the [b]Cross-platform PvP Multiplayer[/b], which means that players can find their opponents, between different devices. Owners of [i]Oculus Rift, HTC Vive, PlayStation VR[/i], and [i]Windows Mixed Reality[/i] devices will be able to compete with each other in places scattered around the Galactic Roman Empire.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/be3bc61db373662a4589e2ea7aba97bf7d0a6f4a.png[/img]


[h1][b]Telefrag VR with Cross-platform PvP Multiplayer[/b][/h1]

Three main reasons why we made such a decision:

• [b]Faster matchmaking [/b] - We know that multiplayer games are best played when there are many players in it. Everybody hates waiting for a long time in the lobby.

• [b]Friends[/b] - We didn't want to cut you off from friends just because they chose a different platform to play.

• [b]Equality[/b] - VR also eliminates one of the most common arguments against crossplay: keyboard + mouse are giving a significant advantage. Not here. Last week we revealed new locomotion type in the game - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1597000763095900919]Smooth locomotion[/url]. Answering your questions from Reddit - we ensure you that both locomotion types ([i]Dash & Smooth[/i]) will be balanced in terms of potential advantages of using one of the mentioned types.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/6ab2d03cdca194ff80bf86f916a744e491e91ff3.png[/img]


[h1][b]Answer the question, win Detached key [PC][/b][/h1]

We have a quick question for you. [b]On which platform and why do you choose to play Telefrag VR?[/b]


The most interesting answer on Steam will be awarded the code for our previous VR game - [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/436230/Detached/]Detached[/url]. 

---

notes.title: We hear your feedback. We're adding smooth movement!
notes.content:
Hi!

After a short Easter break, we're back with redoubled power and important announcement, which dominated our communication channels during the free open beta phase back in March/April.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/315912b28567c6cfc687522bfa6bcabea2cdf1fe.png[/img]

Your feedback, including [b]Steam[/b], [b]Reddit[/b] and [url=https://discord.gg/YCpfVWb][b]Discord[/b][/url] server allowed us to decide on the new movement scheme in the game. Therefore, we have good information for you - smooth movement will be added to the game as an alternative locomotion mode.

[h1][b]Why we implemented the Dash Movement?[/b][/h1]

Up to now, a dash movement has been implemented, which is characterized by short jumps in a designated field. The player's position is changed by analog thumb sticks or body rotation, thanks to which players can move comfortable on the arenas even after passing the tutorial. The dynamic nature of this type of arena shooter in VR required us to solve the key problem faced by players in virtual reality - motion sickness.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b4hCcUUMOZA

[b]Dash movement[/b] should give players a sense of speed and control while avoiding motion sickness, associated with fast movement and accelerations. An additional dimension to dash is "[b]teleport attack[/b]", which, as the name says, can be used not only to change position on the map quickly, but also to bring a bunch of missiles towards the enemy.

[h1][b]Smooth Movement - A few words of introduction
[/b][/h1]

According to your suggestions that we received during the open beta, we decided to [b]implement smooth movement[/b]. Why? In addition to meeting your expectations, we want to reflect further the feeling that accompanied the clashes in the classic arena shooters games. We believe that hardcore players and old FPS champs will enjoy even more fun by telefragging opponents in virtual reality and finding more and more different ways to surprise the enemy, using not only the data structure of the arenas but also the advantages of the new control mode. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/8ee29bd9eab0e0bf5d3df32bf26dc687bc89538e.png[/img]


[b]Smooth movement[/b] also gives you more precise control, so you will not miss the pickups or the teleport gates. ([i]As a reminder, in the game options you can change the rotation angle for the dash movement[/i]). But remember, more freedom also bring some disadvantages. You're more vulnerable to long-range enemy attacks. 

You can change movement scheme at any time. Just select it manually in the game options.

[b]See what free locomotion looks like in action[/b] ([i]click the image below[/i]):

[url=https://imgur.com/a/yFPX0Mi][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/b05d6e73cbca156ef484ad2eb08b1ed2842ddcd9.png[/img][/url]

Remember to keep up with the upcoming information about Telefrag VR! If you have any questions about the new movement scheme, please write to us on the [url=Https://steamcommunity.com/app/916100/discussions/][b]forum[/b][/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/

notes.title: Telefrag VR with 3dRudder support for PC VR and PlayStation VR
notes.content:
Hi there! 

We would like to share with you an awesome news. Prior to [b]Telefrag VR [/b] release, 3dRudder will hit the market, and our game will support this foot-powered motion controller for [b]PC VR [/b]version and [b]PlayStation VR[/b]. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/05d2ca74198ae272208f7e63b3d7f27131af2bbe.png[/img]
[b]3dRudder[/b] is a way to give the players unique kind of steering. This platform rests on a rounded bottom half, thanks to this design, players can use their feet and tilt the whole device in the desired direction. The more angled is the tilt, the faster you will move. 

[h1][b]What is the 3dRudder?[/b][/h1]

"Imagine yourself playing a first-person shooter with a PS Move motion controller in each hand. You come under fire. Thanks to the 3dRudder you can use your feet to dodge incoming attacks and leave your hands to concentrate on firing back, while glancing round for additional enemies. It’s simply a more immersive experience." [i] source: blog.eu.playstation[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/65f0fbfba95d1049dca8abe0967be0a4604b1ae7.png[/img]

[b]Telefrag VR[/b] will feature [b]3dRudder[/b] support at the game's launch. Later we'll give you more insights, how the game with the mentioned controller looks in action. You can find more details about the new motion controller [url=https://www.3drudder.com/]HERE[/url]. Right now we still encourage [b]PC VR[/b] players to try open beta, which is available till 10th April.
